workflow.name: S14c_0E2 Sua anh treo tuong
workflow.description: Sửa 2 ảnh hướng đã chọn ở 0E: ảnh treo có trẻ em thành người lớn da đen; ảnh tường ảnh bỏ thêm lọ hoa giữa bàn (che miệng người nói ở F1b, F5b). Tải BG_A_WEST đã chọn vào IMG_BG_A_WEST_CU, BG_A_SOUTH đã chọn vào IMG_BG_A_SOUTH_CU, chạy, chọn 1 ảnh mỗi node; ảnh đó thay cho BG_A_WEST, BG_A_SOUTH.

nodes.prompt: Edit Image 1, a photo of the empty dining room facing the wall with the framed family photos. Keep everything exactly as in Image 1: the camera position and framing, the walls, the tall china hutch, the low cabinet, the chandelier and its warm light, the table with the lace tablecloth, the chairs, the carpet, the edge of the archway, and every picture frame in the same place, size and color. Change only two things. 1) Remove the flower centerpiece from the table; the lace tablecloth stays bare and flat there, nothing tall on the table. 2) The people inside the framed photos: every person in every photo is a Black American adult, with no children: the two framed photos on top of the tall china hutch each show a group of four or five Black adults; the church photo shows Black adults in their church clothes in front of the altar cross; the small portrait in pink shows a young Black woman in her twenties; the wedding photo and the graduation portraits stay as they are. The photos stay small and a little soft, with no lettering. Looking like an ordinary frame from a real camera with a normal lens, not a render; true-to-life gentle colors; no over-sharpening, no HDR, no CGI look. No people in the room. No subtitles, no captions, no on-screen text, no logos. Final check: the same room and the same frames as in Image 1; no flower centerpiece on the table; only the people inside the photos changed, all Black adults.

Edit Image 1, a photo of the empty dining room seen from the head of the table toward the opening to the living room. Keep everything exactly as in Image 1: the camera position and framing, the walls, the window with its curtains, the peace lily, the opening, the sofa and the floor lamp, the china hutch, the chandelier and its warm light, the table with the lace tablecloth, the chairs, the flower centerpiece, the carpet, and every picture frame in the same place, size and color. Change only the people inside the framed photos on the wall at screen-right and on top of the china hutch: every person in every photo is a Black American adult with brown skin, with no children: the portrait of the older woman with short hair shows an older Black woman with deep brown skin; the group photo shows a group of Black adults; the wedding portrait and the graduation portrait stay as they are. The photos stay small and a little soft, with no lettering. Looking like an ordinary frame from a real camera with a normal lens, not a render; true-to-life gentle colors; no over-sharpening, no HDR, no CGI look. No people in the room. No subtitles, no captions, no on-screen text, no logos. Final check: the same room and the same frames as in Image 1; only the people inside the photos changed, all Black adults.
